summary: Adecoagro S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of its acquisition of the Caarap Mill from Raízen Group, first disclosed July 20, 2026. The final purchase price was R$705 million (~US$136 million), paid in cash, implying ~US$39 per ton of crushing capacity based on 3.5 million tons crushed in 2025-26. The mill is now integrated into Adecoagro's Mato Grosso do Sul cluster. Management expects to boost throughput to 4.5 million tons in 2027 by redirecting excess cane, improving KPIs and cost efficiency. The deal aligns with synergy-driven vertical expansion. Watch for operational integration milestones and 2027 cluster output of 17 million tons.
